inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: Drinking water was not available during outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The playground maintenance checklist is not being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation made a change in space that made the playground unusable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: The director was lacking training in the required topic of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: One employee was lacking training in the required topic of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Documentation for safety drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Three out of four personnel records evaluated were lacking multiple training certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The operation was lacking an up to date menu. The last menu posted was from April 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: The children in care did not wash hands prior to eating lunch.     This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child was observed having their diaper changed and the child's hands were not washed prior to being laid down for nap.     This was corrected when it was addressed with the caregiver and the caregiver washed chilren's hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: Diaper changing supplies were observed to be on and underneath a bench in the main classroom. The diapering supplies were accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: A caregiver ws observed changing a child's diaper on their lap.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver began to change diapers on an appropriate diaper changing table. It was also addressed with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of four children's records evaluated had out of date immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: A caregiver was heard using negative methods of discipline with children in care. The caregiver raised their voice in a negative, harsh tone multiple times. They also utilized negative statements instead of attempting to use positive methods of discipline and guidance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Multiple children were observed in a chair with a tray and safety belt for over 15 minutes after they finished eating. They remained in the chair for approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes.     This was corrected when the children were removed from the restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: Two infants under 18 months old were observed to be combined in a classroom with multiple children ranging in age with the oldest child being 11 years old. There were more than 12 children in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was observed stepping out of their designated classroom multiple times for tasks such as preparing a meal and checking on another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: 3 out of 4 children's records reviewed were lacking a valid health professional statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Employee records were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions were not updated within 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: There were a total of 6 infants in care. This exceeds the amount of infants allowed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 4 out of 4 children's records were lacking admission information such as: address for emergency contact, parent name, physician or hospital information for emergency medical attention, school information, and admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were two uninstalled air conditioning window units in the playground area. The playground also contained a chandelier, rusted items such as a chair and lawn equipment, and there was a pile of wood with rusted nails sticking out. There was also a hammer sitting in the middle of play equipment. There was a broken slide with a puddle of accumluated water on it. Play equipment had a lot of dirt and spiders webs on them. There was also a large spider observed with a spiderweb in the playground area. There was a fallen tree limb inside of the fencing of the playground area. There was siding on the building that appears to be damaged and has nails sticking out. This siding was located in the area fenced for the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The center was not operating in compliance with multiple minimum standards. Multiple required postings were either out of date or missing. There was not an adequate amount of staff for the center to operate in compliance with standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 out of 4 children's records reviewed had out of date or missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included: There was a 12 year old related to a caregiver laying down in the kitchen area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included (26 TAC §746.1507(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The annual certified consumer product safety had not been signed since 2022.

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children: A 7 month old and a 12 month old were combined in a classroom with multiple children ranging in age from 5 years old to 12 years old. There were more than 12 children in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.2403(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to submit the number of employees that have left their employment in 2023 by January 15th.
